parsed.rationale: Both `HSBColor.uiColor` and `HSBColor.nsColor` are computed properties in `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift` within the `ColorPalette` package. Despite a Jaccard similarity of 0.71, these two properties are intentionally distinct: `uiColor` targets UIKit (iOS/tvOS) and `nsColor` targets AppKit (macOS). Their structural similarity is a natural consequence of both converting the same HSB color model to a platform color type — the parallel shape is load-bearing platform-specific behavior, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the platform boundary and likely require conditional compilation that is harder to read than the current side-by-side declarations.
